auditor-jen (external): Hi team, auditor request: need an evidence bundle linking RBAC changes to KMS rotations or accesses for the Oct rotation window. Map to SOC2 CC6.1 and ISO A.10. Provide one sanitized log line proving approver and rotation event, and the alert/playbook name. Time window: 2025-10-01..2025-10-07.

lina (eng-security): Got it. We keep PR history in infra/iam-config (2 reviewers required), merge triggers deployment which emits CloudTrail events and a CI audit record. Artifacts staged in s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms-lite/.

max (infra): Splunk sample queries: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=AttachRolePolicy OR eventName=PutRolePolicy earliest=2025-10-01 latest=2025-10-07 | table _time, userIdentity.userName, eventName, requestParameters
```
KMS rotation: 
```
index=cloudtrail eventName=EnableKeyRotation OR eventName=RotateKey earliest=2025-10-01 latest=2025-10-07 | table _time, eventName, requestParameters.keyId, userIdentity.userName
```

lina (eng-security): Sanitized extracts below: 
```
_time: 2025-10-03T11:05:12Z | userName: max-infra | eventName: AttachRolePolicy | roleName: svc-secrets-reader
_time: 2025-10-05T03:00:01Z | userName: kms-rotator | eventName: EnableKeyRotation | requestParameters.keyId: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123:key/rot-42
```
Both maps are included in the package `rbac-kms-lite-2025-10.tar.gz` (manifest and checksums present).

auditor-jen (external): Please show the alert/playbook name that ties RBAC changes to KMS activity.

max (infra): Alert rule name: `IAM-KMS-Privilege-Change-Alert`. If a role attachment affects a principal that owns a key tag=prod within 1h of a Decrypt -> alert fires to #eng-security and creates SEC ticket. Playbook: `kms_privilege_change_playbook_v1`.

alert-bot: evidence-snapshot created: lite-2025-10-08-001 -> uploaded to s3://redwood-compliance/evidence/q4-2025/rbac-kms-lite/package.tar.gz; manifest signed.

auditor-jen (external): Thanks. I'll validate checksums and the crosswalk mapping to CC6.1/A.10. If we need raw JSON contexts I'll request short-term access.

lina (eng-security): Thanks 44d. Ping here if you need more detail or different redaction level.
